flower_gate: >=3 years, >=20 checks, and both flowering/non-flowering observations for a native candidate in the state
bee_gate: >=25 records, >=3 years, >=10 weeks, >=3 grid cells for a native bee in the state
full_release_gate: >=20 supported plants, >=20 activity-supported bees, >=10 linked plants, >=10 linked bees, >=25 strict A/B edges
limitations: GBIF records are opportunistic presences. Strict links are national documented evidence, not proof of a local interaction at every location. This audit is eligibility for a standardized state pipeline, not a claim of local recommendation validity.
